messages:
emma (DevEx): FYI onboarding CI started failing for ruby/sample-sdk after a typegen regen this morning. changelog auto-bumped a minor even though the diff looks like ordering-only. anyone else seeing this?
raj (codegen): yup. we shipped a stable-sort for example params which can reorder examples. that changes example hashes -> changelog differences -> semver guard trips.
emma (DevEx): build 11234 failing at `publish-sdk:changelog-guard`. tiny diff but automation treats it as public API change.
ci-bot: build 11234 failed at step `publish-sdk:changelog-guard`. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/11234/logs
jordan (infra): also seeing a flaky timeout in `sampleapp_auth_retry_test` on ruby only (120s vs expected 30s). node/python pass.
maya (SDK lead): ruby's auth header ordering historically differs (Authorization before Content-Type). our example generator included raw header snapshots; that can affect example determinism.
raj (codegen): snippet of the example delta: ```diff
- parameters: ["user_id", "session_id"]
+ parameters: ["session_id", "user_id"]
```
raj (codegen): i'll add a `--stable-examples` flag and enforce canonical sort by param name when emitting examples. unit test for example-hash stability too.
emma (DevEx): nice. short-term mitigation? we need to get the release unblocked.
jordan (infra): can gate the publish job with an env var `PUBLISH_ALLOW_MANUAL_OVERRIDE=true` for this branch only and require two approvals to proceed. i'll add that to CI.
maya (SDK lead): i'll pin the typegen version in the ruby sample's publish workflow and open a quick PR to bump the sample test timeout and make the mock auth deterministic.\emma (DevEx): can we add a tiny integration test asserting header order doesn't change generated examples? catches regression earlier.
raj (codegen): yes. adding a test and the regen-check e2e in typegen CI. will also add a comment explaining why examples are sorted to avoid future accidental reverts.
maya (SDK lead): owners: raj -> typegen patch + tests, maya -> pin in ruby sample + test fix, jordan -> CI gate. will paste PR links here.
emma (DevEx): thanks team :thumbsup: paste PR links when ready so I can update the release checklist.
